chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Yazid ibn Ishaq, from Harun ibn Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The testimony of two women is valid in the case of Istihlal.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the testimony of two women in Istihlal according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the permissibility of two women's testimony for Istihlal, a legal mechanism used to determine pregnancy status, often in the context of resolving marital disputes or establishing lineage. It reflects the flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding female testimony, distinguishing between contexts where two women suffice versus those requiring a man and two women, as derived from the chain narrated by Abu Basir. This ruling underscores the practical application of evidentiary rules in personal status law within the Ja'fari school.
